reuse.why: The flag goes into the existing isSkippedByMonthActions predicate and the getMonthActionCategories selector, which every month-wide action already uses.

duplication.why: The hidden rule is decided once. The only repetition is the same optional parameter threaded through six action signatures, which their per-action argument objects make unavoidable.

placement.why: The exclusion rule stays in the shared predicate in budget/actions.ts next to the other exclusions, and the actions just pass the flag along.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions and their shared selection are touched; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Clear and explicit, but there are no tests for the new flag, and six near-identical signature edits would have to be repeated for any future option.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action (copyPreviousMonth via the predicate, the others via getMonthActionCategories) uses the shared definition.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the hidden rule stays in one predicate.
